description: Faceted full-text search over one collection (scope). Every filter is a property of this schema, the same params as REST GET /api/v1/search; values of a fixed list are matched in any case. A bad value or an unknown argument is an invalid-params error whose data lists every problem (errors[]). Tender hits carry lifecycle, deadline_at, accepts_bids and source_url when the source gives them. Returns {hits, found, page, per_page, facets}.

accepts_bids.description: true: only open tenders whose bid deadline is still ahead.

added_after.description: Unix seconds. Only tenders added to Sell to State after this time. With sort=added_desc, a polling trigger keeps the time of its last run and asks for the rows after it.

awarded_days.description: Awarded in the last N days (UTC days).

date_days.description: Published or awarded in the last N days (UTC days).

has_amount.description: true: only rows with an amount. false: only rows without one.

lifecycle_mode.description: is (default) keeps the lifecycle values; is_not leaves them out.

match.description: Text match mode for the suppliers and buyers scopes.

published_days.description: Published in the last N days (UTC days). 1 is the last day, for polling.

scope.description: The collection to search. Default tenders.

sort.description: relevance (default), deadline (the nearest bid deadline first), published_desc (the newest publish date first) or added_desc (the newest rows in Sell to State first). Tenders scope only.

status.description: Countries scope only: data (the country has data) or coming_soon.

type.description: Procurement type, for example works, goods or services. Only some countries have it.

year_max.description: Latest year (award year, else publication year).

year_min.description: Earliest year (award year, else publication year).

name: search
title: Search tenders, buyers and suppliers
